lines.zh: 我用渡渡鸟的步态走着，身子一晃
lines.en: I walk with a dodo's waddle, rocking side to side.

lines.zh: 巨头在前，短腿在后面追
lines.en: My huge head leads and my short legs catch up.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩得很重，像在跺脚
lines.en: Every step lands heavy, almost a stomp.

lines.zh: 我左右张望，边走边看有没有吃的
lines.en: I look both ways as I walk, hunting for food.

lines.zh: 小翅膀在身侧甩来甩去，没用
lines.en: My tiny wings flail at my sides, useless.

lines.zh: 牙床露在外面，我走得很得意
lines.en: My jaw of teeth shows; I walk with pride.

lines.zh: 我从鸡窝边经过，脚步停了一下
lines.en: I pass a chicken coop and my steps slow.

lines.zh: 沉重的尾巴在后面拖出一道痕
lines.en: My heavy tail drags a groove behind me.

lines.zh: 我走路的样子，一半像鸟一半像暴君
lines.en: I walk half bird, half tyrant.

lines.zh: 脖子一伸一缩，我在闻地面
lines.en: My neck pumps as I sniff the ground.

lines.zh: 这个身体太笨，但我毫不在意
lines.en: This body is clumsy, and I do not care.

lines.zh: 踩到自己的影子，我低头咬了一口
lines.en: I step on my own shadow and bite it.

lines.zh: 我绕过石头，羽毛抖了抖
lines.en: I go around a stone and ruffle my feathers.

lines.zh: 走两步就停下来，看看有没有人在看我
lines.en: Two steps, then a pause to check who is watching.

lines.zh: 我站着发呆，嘴里还留着一条虫
lines.en: I stand dazed, a worm still in my mouth.

lines.zh: 巨大的头上顶着一撮乱羽
lines.en: A tuft of messy feathers crowns my huge head.

lines.zh: 我低头啄了啄胸口，很满足
lines.en: I peck my own chest, well content.

lines.zh: 这身体里有一半是渡渡鸟的懒
lines.en: Half of this body is dodo laziness.

lines.zh: 我打了个嗝，声音像小号
lines.en: I burp, and it sounds like a small horn.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，从来没人教过我
lines.en: I fear nothing; no one ever taught me to.

lines.zh: 牙露在外面，笑起来很凶
lines.en: My teeth show, and my smile looks fierce.

lines.zh: 翅膀太小，我早就不指望它
lines.en: My wings are too small; I gave up on them long ago.

lines.zh: 我歪头看天，好像在算什么
lines.en: I tilt my head at the sky as if calculating.

lines.zh: 脚趾抓地，我准备随时跑或者不跑
lines.en: My toes grip the ground, ready to run, or not.

lines.zh: 风吹过羽毛，我舒服得眯起眼
lines.en: Wind through my feathers makes me squint happily.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴轻轻拍地，一下一下
lines.en: My tail taps the ground, once, then again.

lines.zh: 我记得这里有一丛浆果
lines.en: I remember a berry bush around here.

lines.zh: 站着不动的时候，我像个大号的鸡
lines.en: Standing still, I am an oversized chicken.

lines.zh: 我把巨头低下来，凑近看你
lines.en: I lower my huge head to look at you up close.

lines.zh: 你比我高，这让我有点不高兴
lines.en: You are taller than me, and that annoys me.

lines.zh: 我扭头，一只眼看你，另一只看别处
lines.en: One eye on you, the other elsewhere.

lines.zh: 牙一颗颗露出来，我不是故意的
lines.en: My teeth show one by one; it is not on purpose.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻你的鞋，觉得能吃
lines.en: I sniff your boots and decide they might be edible.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我先动了一下
lines.en: You stay still, so I make the first move.

lines.zh: 小翅膀扑了两下，算是打招呼
lines.en: A couple of flaps from my tiny wings, a greeting.

lines.zh: 我认得你是养我的人吗？我记不清
lines.en: Are you the one who raised me? I forget.

lines.zh: 我抬脚在地上刨了两下
lines.en: I scrape the ground twice with my foot.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我可以一口咬到
lines.en: At this distance I could bite you.

lines.zh: 我偏头，像在想该不该客气
lines.en: I tilt my head, wondering whether to be polite.

lines.zh: 你身上有食物的味道，我记住了
lines.en: You smell of food; I have noted it.

lines.zh: 我走过去，用头蹭了蹭你的腿
lines.en: I walk over and rub my head on your leg.

lines.zh: 我们互相对视，我先眨眼
lines.en: We stare; I blink first.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里发出咕咕的声音
lines.en: A cooing sound rises in my throat.

lines.zh: 我不是宠物，我是半个暴君
lines.en: I am no pet; I am half a tyrant.

lines.zh: 我惨叫一声，很没面子
lines.en: I yelp once, deeply undignified.

lines.zh: 我扑腾着小翅膀往后退
lines.en: I flap my tiny wings and retreat.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了好几根，我心疼
lines.en: Several feathers fall; I mourn them.

lines.zh: 我扭头看伤口，够不着
lines.en: I twist to see the wound and cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 我咕咕叫着，声音都抖了
lines.en: I coo, and my voice trembles.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我的自尊上
lines.en: That blow landed on my pride.

lines.zh: 我踉跄着转了两圈才站住
lines.en: I stagger two circles before stopping.

lines.zh: 血渗进羽毛，颜色变深
lines.en: Blood soaks into my feathers, darkening them.

lines.zh: 我低头撞了一下地，泄愤
lines.en: I butt the ground once in frustration.

lines.zh: 别看我笨，我记得谁打的
lines.en: Do not mistake me for dull; I remember who hit me.

lines.zh: 我闻到种子味，整颗头都探过来
lines.en: I smell seeds and my whole head leans in.

lines.zh: 我不挑，什么都吃
lines.en: I am not picky; I eat anything.

lines.zh: 嘴巴张得老大，等东西掉进去
lines.en: Mouth wide open, waiting for things to fall in.

lines.zh: 我小跑着过来，姿态很滑稽
lines.en: I trot over, looking utterly ridiculous.

lines.zh: 这一把不够，我还想要
lines.en: That handful is not enough; I want more.

lines.zh: 我围着食物转，先看有没有危险
lines.en: I circle the food, checking for danger first.

lines.zh: 渡渡鸟的胃，暴龙的牙
lines.en: A dodo's stomach, a tyrant's teeth.

lines.zh: 我叼住就吞，嚼都懒得嚼
lines.en: I grab and swallow, too lazy to chew.

lines.zh: 我给你让个位置，只要分我一口
lines.en: I make room for you, just give me a bite.

lines.zh: 我把头伸到你手里，很没出息
lines.en: I push my head into your hand, shamelessly.

lines.zh: 我被撞得晃了一下，站住了
lines.en: I rock from the bump but stay standing.

lines.zh: 我太沉，撞上来你就弹开
lines.en: I am too heavy; hitting me bounces you off.

lines.zh: 牙磕到你，咔的一声
lines.en: My teeth clack against you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，羽毛掉了两根
lines.en: We collide and two feathers drift down.

lines.zh: 我回头瞪你，很不服气
lines.en: I turn and glare at you, deeply offended.

lines.zh: 腿太短，我退不开
lines.en: My legs are too short to step back.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我重心歪了
lines.en: The hit throws my balance off.

lines.zh: 我低头拱你，像只大号的猪
lines.en: I lower my head and shove you like a giant pig.

lines.zh: 地上的土被我们扬起一片
lines.en: Dust rises around us.

lines.zh: 我甩甩身子，把撞的地方抖顺
lines.en: I shake my body to settle the spot.

lines.zh: 我把羽毛蓬开，显得更大一点
lines.en: I fluff my feathers to look bigger.

lines.zh: 我跳了一段笨拙的舞，脚都打结
lines.en: I dance clumsily, feet tangling.

lines.zh: 我们头碰头，牙撞了一下
lines.en: Our heads touch, and our teeth clack.

lines.zh: 窝在背风的树下，我带你过去
lines.en: The nest is under a sheltered tree; I lead you there.

lines.zh: 我叼来干草，堆成一圈
lines.en: I bring dry grass and pile it in a ring.

lines.zh: 我轻轻叫，声音比平时细
lines.en: I call softly, thinner than usual.

lines.zh: 你替我啄掉背上的杂物
lines.en: You pick debris off my back.

lines.zh: 两个巨头挤在一起，很挤
lines.en: Two huge heads crowd together, tight.

lines.zh: 这一窝蛋，我得看着别被偷
lines.en: I will have to watch the eggs for thieves.

lines.zh: 渡渡暴龙也有温柔的时候
lines.en: Even a Raphus rex has tender moments.

lines.zh: 我一口吞下，喉咙鼓了一下
lines.en: I swallow it whole, my throat bulging.

lines.zh: 我叼着种子，掉了一半
lines.en: I hold seeds and drop half of them.

lines.zh: 这东西比石头软，是吃的
lines.en: This is softer than stone; it is food.

lines.zh: 我用脚踩住，再用嘴撕
lines.en: I pin it with a foot and tear with my beak.

lines.zh: 我叼起来甩了两下，确定死了
lines.en: I shake it twice to be sure it is dead.

lines.zh: 太小了，我得多捡几个
lines.en: Too small, so I need several more.

lines.zh: 我把它藏到巢边，留作宵夜
lines.en: I stash it by the nest for a midnight snack.

lines.zh: 牙咬不开，我换了角度
lines.en: My teeth cannot crack it; I try another angle.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进嘴里，装作没有
lines.en: I stuff it in my mouth and pretend otherwise.

lines.zh: 叼着这个，我走路更摇摆了
lines.en: Carrying this makes my waddle worse.

lines.zh: 那东西在动，而且能吃
lines.en: That thing moves, and it is edible.

lines.zh: 我盯上了你，因为你在动
lines.en: I fix on you because you are moving.

lines.zh: 我低头，牙先往前伸
lines.en: Head lowered, my teeth lead the way.

lines.zh: 小东西跑得快，但跑不远
lines.en: The little thing is quick, but not far.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢有人抢我的食
lines.en: I do not like anyone near my food.

lines.zh: 我盯住你了，别以为我笨
lines.en: I have my eye on you; do not mistake me for slow.

lines.zh: 这一口，应该够饱
lines.en: One bite of that should fill me.

lines.zh: 我脚下刨了两下，准备冲
lines.en: I scrape my feet twice, ready to charge.

lines.zh: 它的气味被风带过来了
lines.en: The wind brings its scent to me.

lines.zh: 我不追远的，只追近的
lines.en: I chase what is near, not what is far.

lines.zh: 我发出低沉的咕咕声
lines.en: A deep coo rumbles in my chest.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，这让我更大胆
lines.en: You step back, and that emboldens me.

lines.zh: 我把脖子压低，像要啄
lines.en: I drop my neck as if to peck.

lines.zh: 决定了，就是你
lines.en: Decided: you.

lines.zh: 我一步一晃地跟着你
lines.en: I follow you, rocking step by step.

lines.zh: 你跑，我追，我腿短但不停
lines.en: You run, I chase; short legs but relentless.

lines.zh: 我张嘴喘气，牙全露着
lines.en: I pant with my mouth open, all teeth showing.

lines.zh: 我绕你的侧面试探
lines.en: I test your flank by circling.

lines.zh: 你在树后，我直接绕过去
lines.en: You hide behind a tree; I simply walk around.

lines.zh: 我撞开挡路的东西，不停
lines.en: I shove obstacles aside without stopping.

lines.zh: 这股执拗，一半来自渡渡鸟
lines.en: This stubbornness is half dodo.

lines.zh: 我离你越来越近，脚步声很重
lines.en: I close in, footsteps heavy.

lines.zh: 我不怕你反击，我皮厚
lines.en: I do not fear your counter, my hide is thick.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，我停下来看
lines.en: You back to a corner; I pause to look.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把口水甩到一旁
lines.en: I toss my head, flinging drool aside.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我随时能扑
lines.en: At this range I can lunge anytime.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，像在宣布
lines.en: I give a cry, as if announcing it.

lines.zh: 你还想跑？我都追到这儿了
lines.en: Still running? I have chased you this far.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经到你脚下了
lines.en: My shadow has reached your feet.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下，牙扎进去
lines.en: I bite down, teeth sinking in.

lines.zh: 巨头撞过来，像一柄槌
lines.en: My huge head swings like a mallet.

lines.zh: 我抬脚踹，力量不小
lines.en: I kick out, and it carries weight.

lines.zh: 这具身体里，暴龙的部分醒了
lines.en: The tyrant part of me wakes up.

lines.zh: 我甩头撕扯，羽毛全炸开
lines.en: I whip my head to tear, feathers exploding.

lines.zh: 我咬住再往前推
lines.en: I bite and drive forward.

lines.zh: 小翅膀乱扑，只是助威
lines.en: My tiny wings flap wildly, merely cheering me on.

lines.zh: 你被撞退，我紧跟一步
lines.en: You stagger back; I follow one step.

lines.zh: 咕咕声变成了低吼
lines.en: The coo becomes a growl.

lines.zh: 我踩住你的影子，再咬
lines.en: I pin your shadow, then bite.

lines.zh: 渡渡鸟的笨拙里，藏着暴龙的力量
lines.en: Under the dodo's clumsiness hides a tyrant's strength.

lines.zh: 这一口，我练了很久
lines.en: I have practiced that bite a long time.

lines.zh: 我退开两步，甩甩头
lines.en: I back two steps and shake my head.

lines.zh: 我咬完还舔了舔牙
lines.en: I lick my teeth after the bite.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来时，就比别的雏大一号
lines.en: I hatched bigger than the other chicks.

lines.zh: 湿地里传来沉重的脚步声
lines.en: Heavy footsteps sound in the marsh.

lines.zh: 巨头先探出来，然后是身体
lines.en: My huge head appears first, then the rest.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖羽毛，全是水
lines.en: I shake my feathers; water everywhere.

lines.zh: 这里有吃的味道，我留下了
lines.en: This place smells of food; I am staying.

lines.zh: 一声像喇叭的鸣叫响起来
lines.en: A horn-like call rings out.

lines.zh: 我把 DNA 的两半都带在身上
lines.en: I carry both halves of my DNA with me.

lines.zh: 别问我怎么长成这样的
lines.en: Do not ask how I turned out this way.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，草都被压平
lines.en: Where I walk, the grass lies flat.

lines.zh: 渡渡鸟的温和，暴龙的牙
lines.en: A dodo's calm, a tyrant's teeth.

lines.zh: 我从林子里晃出来，像走错了片场
lines.en: I waddle out of the woods, clearly in the wrong film.

lines.zh: 我闻到了熟悉的味道，这是我出生的地方
lines.en: I smell something familiar; this is where I was born.

lines.zh: 小翅膀一抖，我摆了个架势
lines.en: My small wings twitch; I strike a pose.

lines.zh: 地上的虫子都躲进土里
lines.en: The bugs all burrow away.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，算是打招呼
lines.en: I give one call as a greeting.

lines.zh: 这里的地很软，适合我走
lines.en: The ground is soft here, good for my walk.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，比周围的灌木还高
lines.en: I raise my head, taller than the shrubs.

lines.zh: 一半家禽一半暴君，我到了
lines.en: Half fowl, half tyrant, and I have arrived.

lines.zh: 火一舔，羽毛焦了一片
lines.en: Fire licks me, and a patch of feathers chars.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，屁股先着地
lines.en: I fall from a height, landing on my rear.

lines.zh: 水灌进我张着的嘴，我猛咳
lines.en: Water pours into my open mouth; I cough hard.

lines.zh: 我被气浪推得翻了个跟头
lines.en: The blast rolls me head over heels.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在背上，像根刺
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back like a thorn.

lines.zh: 身上发烫，可我看不见火
lines.en: My body burns, yet I see no flame.

lines.zh: 我饿得开始啃树皮
lines.en: Hunger has me chewing bark.

lines.zh: 雷打得我羽毛全竖起来
lines.en: Lightning stands every feather on end.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我扑腾着往下掉
lines.en: The ground vanishes; I flail as I fall.
